title: How Dario Amodei built Anthropic's tightly knit culture with essays, Slack memos, and "Vision Quest" talks, as Anthropic seeds his ideas with opinion-makers (Nitasha Tiku/Washington Post)
summary: Nitasha Tiku / Washington Post: How Dario Amodei built Anthropic's tightly knit culture with essays, Slack memos, and “Vision Quest” talks, as Anthropic seeds his ideas with opinion-makers — Anthropic is worth more than $1 trillion. CEO Dario Amodei also wants to sell the world on his philosophy of the future.
